botc-notes.title: Notes
botc-notes.placeholder:
Press %1$s to show/hide the note
Press %2$s to write, move or resize
botc-notes.config.title: BotC Notes — settings
botc-notes.config.cursor_mode.press.tip: Press once to free the mouse, press again (or Esc, or click outside) to take it back.
botc-notes.config.cursor_mode.hold.tip: The mouse stays free while the key is held. Clicking into the note to write keeps it open until Esc or a click outside.
